## Problem

Explain the concrete user or contributor problem and link any related issue.
English and Chinese are welcome.

## Change

Describe what changes and the resulting behavior. Name the affected Editor, document service, plugin, export or example components where relevant.

## Verification

Describe the checks you actually ran, their results and any material limitation. For visual changes, include reviewed before/after images. For host integration or PowerPoint behavior, say which actual application was exercised.

## Public assets and document changes

If this change adds screenshots, figures, example projects or exports, record their source and license. Confirm that the submitted files contain no private project data or credentials. For deck changes, identify the project and pages and summarize shared-writer verification.
